title: Permissions: 403 on the lookup without WO or Part View and on the credit list without Invoice Create & Edit
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logins: Admin; a custom role with neither Work Order View nor Part View; a custom role without Invoice Create & Edit. A paid part sale at Staging Heavy Duty (note its invoice id). API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com: Network tab, right-click a captured request > Copy as fetch, edit method/URL/body in the Console; header X-Location-ID = the current location's id. As Admin, capture GET /api/work-orders/part/request/inventory-parts-as-options-with-remaining-catalogue-parts?search=QAPL (work order line > Add Part > type QAPL) and GET /api/part-sales/<invoiceId>/list-credit-available-parts (part sale > Issue credit memo), and copy both as fetch.
custom_steps:
1. As Admin, replay both requests.
  2. Log in as the role with neither Work Order View nor Part View; replay the lookup request.
  3. Log in as the role without Invoice Create & Edit; replay the credit-list request.
  4. Log back in as Admin and replay both requests again.
custom_expected:
1. Both 200: the lookup lists the active QAPL parts; the credit list lists the invoice's parts.
  2. 403; no part rows are returned.
  3. 403; no credit-available parts are returned.
  4. Both 200 with the same content as step 1: the refusals changed nothing.
